text:
mika-sales: Contoso needs MSA+DPA redlines fast, procurement needs PO mapping; POC blocked. Can legal triage? @nora-legal

nora-legal: Looking. Immediate asks: remove insurer carveout in 7.2, add EU data residency option, and confirm acceptance of our KMS addendum for BYOK. Ask them to upload any redline of our MSA.

tony-ops: Procurement notes net45 preferred and W-9 required. We can run POC on eval credits and mark SOW $0 until PO arrives. Need invoice to reference PO #PT-009 once issued.

lena-customer: PO timeline ~10 business days. Can sign SOW today to unblock POC next week. We'll use DocuSign.

ravi-se: Proposed unblock path: 1) Send DPA + zero-dollar POC SOW now; 2) Provision hosted eval and sandbox; 3) Start POC while MSA negotiation continues. Works for us.

sec-bot: Attached: SOC2 Type II certs and network diagrams (link). Hosted doesn't support customer KMS for production; Dedicated does. For trial we can offer a KMS bridge exception.

nora-legal: OK to proceed with DPA+SOW if DPA includes controller instructions and 15-day deletion SLA post-termination. I'll prepare a short redline and share Drive link. Also require signer names for MSA vs SOW.

mika-sales: Lena, who signs which doc? We'll need DocuSign routing.

lena-customer: I will route SOW; legal will sign MSA. DocuSign is fine.

tony-ops: Ops notes: set SOW amount $0, include PO-pending placeholder, W-9 before production billing. Reserving eval slot Tue 08:00-16:00 UTC pending signed SOW.

ravi-se: I'll provision sandbox after SOW signs. Billing clause suggestion: "Trial period is non-billable; charges apply only after explicit production order form execution."

nora-legal: Good. Small tweak: add explicit "no charge" for trial and keep right to bill for opted-in paid add-ons. Deletion timeline 15 days. Uploading redline now.

mika-sales: Thanks team. I'll send DPA+SOW+SOC2 bundle to Contoso and post DocuSign envelope id here once sent. Contingency: ask Contoso to upload any MSA redline and we'll continue POC in parallel.
